related_issues.reason: Same area: index/resolution settings not honoured when [required-]environments is set; the report is about a different setting, so it is context rather than a duplicate.
Bug where required-environments is not respected in combination with fork-strategy fewest; shows required-environments handling in universal resolution has known gaps, but is a different symptom.
required-environments producing a false-positive resolution failure under uv sync; opposite direction (over-strict) from this report (under-strict in uv pip compile).
Enhancement request to add the current platform to required-environments by default; touches the same setting but asks for a different behaviour.
Documentation issue about marker limits in required-environments; same setting, different problem.

rationale: The docs (concepts/resolution.md, Required environments section) say required-environments expands the platforms uv must support and should fail if no compatible wheel exists, and that --universal is available in the pip interface. The reporter's pip compile --universal run with required-environments set succeeds with no error for hdbscan 0.8.42, which has no aarch64 py3.12 wheel and is no-build, while uv lock with the same config fails as documented. The pip-interface behaviour therefore contradicts the documented setting and nothing external explains it, so bug. No exact duplicate was found in search results (searches on 'required-environments pip compile' and 'required-environments'). I could not inspect the source, so confidence is medium; I did not verify whether uv pip compile reads [tool.uv] required-environments in every code path.
